name: Thanksgiving & Christmas Roasted Turkey Breast with Strained Pan Gravy
groceryIngredients: Whole Turkey or Bone-In Turkey Breast
whyItWorks: Carved skinless white-meat turkey breast is 100% fiber-free, ultra-lean, and rich in L-tryptophan and B-vitamins—the safest centerpiece on any Thanksgiving or Christmas table.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Carve slices from the interior white turkey breast (skipping heavily peppered/crispy skin if flaring) and top with smooth strained bone-broth pan gravy (no chopped giblets or onions).
watchOuts: Skip crispy heavily seasoned skin and chunky giblet/mushroom gravies
